neighbours.label: the placement of an object in a mechanics word problem ('rests on a ramp', 'hangs in an elevator', 'stands on a scale'), plus 'invest mainly in'
fire: A 3-kg crate sits on a horizontal floor with a coefficient of kinetic friction of 0.2.
A 2-kg ball hangs from a string attached to the ceiling of a moving train.
A man of mass 70 kg stands on a bathroom scale inside an elevator that accelerates upward.
A 10-kg box rests on a ramp inclined at 30 degrees to the horizontal.
A block of mass 4 kg slides on a frictionless table and hits a spring.
A pendulum bob is suspended in a lift that moves downward at constant speed.
A small coin is placed on a turntable rotating at 33 revolutions per minute.
Canadian pension funds invest mainly in infrastructure and real estate abroad.
quiet: A 3-kg crate has a kinetic energy of 24 joules; find its speed.
The momentum of a ball doubles when its velocity doubles.
A man of mass 70 kg climbs a staircase 4 metres high in ten seconds.
The ramp was 30 metres long and painted bright yellow for the race.
Calculate the work done when a force of 10 N moves an object 5 metres.
The pendulum clock in the hallway chimes once every hour.
Convert 33 revolutions per minute into radians per second.
Canadian pension funds have grown quickly over the last decade.

notes: Weak pole (max 4.75). Probe: 'block rests on an inclined plane' 0.45 (peak ' on'), 'mass hangs in an elevator moving upward' 0.49, 'invests mainly in' 0.45; 'consists primarily of' 0.06 and 'focuses mostly on' 0.01, so not focus adverbs generally. Near misses are mechanics questions without an object placed on/in something.
